SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT * FROM( SELECT DISTINCT A.BUYER, A.INV_NO FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_INV_SEND A WHERE A.BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'BING') AND A.IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY A.BUYER, A.INV_NO ) WHERE ROWNUM < 10
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT '000' AS HOUSE_CODE , '1000' AS COMPANY_CODE , F_SPLIT(F.IV_COLUMN,'^',2) AS SELLER_CODE , F_SPLIT(F.IV_COLUMN,'^',3) AS PO_COUNT , DECODE(A.STATUS,'C','1','2') AS INV_COUNT , D.PLANT AS PLANT_CODE , A.INV_NO AS INV_NUMBER , A.INV_SEQ AS INV_SEQ , A.LEGACY_PO_NO AS PO_NUMBER , A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AS PO_SEQ , B.INV_TTL_AMT AS INV_TTL_AMT , C.ITEM_AMT AS INV_AMT , B.CUR AS CUR , 'N' AS IV_STATUS , DECODE(A.STATUS,'C','N','Y') AS DEL_FLAG , B.ADD_DATE AS ADD_DATE , B.ADD_TIME AS ADD_TIME ,(SELECT T.LEGACY_USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR T WHERE T.USER_ID = B.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_ID , A.INV_DATE AS INV_DATE , (SELECT IL.USER_NAME_LOC FROM KEP.ICOMLUSR IL WHERE USER_ID = (SELECT MBM.KEP_USER_ID FROM KEP.MIS_BUYER_MNG MBM WHERE MBM.BUYER = A.BUYER AND MBM.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') AND MBM.POSITION_GROUP = 'PM' AND STATUS = 'C' AND ROWNUM = 1) ) AS SALES_PERSON_NAME , (SELECT IL.PHONE_NUMBER FROM KEP.ICOMLUSR IL WHERE USER_ID = (SELECT MBM.KEP_USER_ID FROM KEP.MIS_BUYER_MNG MBM WHERE MBM.BUYER = A.BUYER AND MBM.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') AND MBM.POSITION_GROUP = 'PM' AND STATUS = 'C' AND ROWNUM = 1) ) AS SALES_PERSON_TEL , A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS MATERIAL_NUMBER , C.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION_LOC , C.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION , F_SPLIT(F.IV_COLUMN,'^',1) AS MAKER_NAME , C.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE , A.ITEM_QTY AS INV_QTY , A.ATTR_02 AS ITEM_QTY , C.UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE , A.ATTR_01 AS PO_RD_DATE , E.PO_CREATE_DATE AS PO_CREATE_DATE FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_INV_SEND A , ICOMIVHD B , ICOMIVDT C , ICOMPODT D , ICOMPOHD E , ICOMPRDT F WHERE 1=1 AND A.INV_NO = C.INV_NO AND A.INV_SEQ = C.INV_SEQ AND A.BUYER = C.BUYER
AND B.INV_NO = C.INV_NO AND B.BUYER = C.BUYER
AND C.PO_NO = D.PO_NO AND C.PO_SEQ = D.PO_SEQ AND C.BUYER = D.BUYER
AND C.PR_NO = F.PR_NO AND C.PR_SEQ = F.PR_SEQ AND C.BUYER = F.BUYER
AND D.PO_NO = E.PO_NO AND D.BUYER = E.BUYER AND A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.INV_NO = '$G_RS.INV_NO$'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_INV_SEND A SET A.IF_FLAG = 'Y' , A.IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , A.IF_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.INV_NO = '$G_RS.INV_NO$'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_INV_SEND A SET A.IF_FLAG = 'E' , A.IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , A.IF_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.INV_NO = '$G_RS.INV_NO$'
